Commentary.Commentary: We are ready! Six balls for each team to win the match! Dasun Shanaka and Dinesh Chandimal have come out to bat for Sri Lanka. Josh Hazlewood has the ball in hand.

Right then. In the Super Over, the team that batted second will bat first which means that Lankans will have to set a target. The big question is which two batters will be sent out? Pathum Nissanka certainly seems the likely choice and also the skipper will probably come out. Also, Josh Hazlewood can be seen warming up with the ball which means that he will bowl for Australia.

My word! What an unreal game of cricket have we just witnessed! And the best part is that it is not over yet. That final blow from Dushmantha Chameera has levelled the scores and a Super Over will now follow. Sri Lanka have done the unthinkable here and who knows, they might just snatch victory here.

FOUR! Yes, we are indeed! Super over it is! Marcus Stoinis bowls a poor delivery, a full toss, outside off. Dushmantha Chameera walks down the pitch and smacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary. The match is tied and it will be decided via a Super Over now. Well, well, well. Just imagine, had the previous ball been called a wide, this match would have been dusted and we would be going to Canberra 1-1.

Touch fuller, outside off, on the tramline. Maheesh Theekshana reaches out for it and has a slash but misses. The batters take a bye. Matthew Wade throws the ball to Marcus Stoinis and he has a shy at his end but misses. Had that hit, it would have been curtains for Maheesh Theekshana. 5 needed from the last ball. Are we in for a Super Over? Also, on the replay it looks to be beyond the tramline. Have the Lankans been dealt a blow here with that ball not being called a wide?

SIX! BOOOMMM! The match is still not over! Stay where you are! Unreal attempt from Steven Smith though in the deep! He almost saved six runs for his side. Length ball, on middle. Maheesh Theekshana smacks it to deep mid-wicket. Steven Smith leaps and flicks the ball in. He injuries himself trying to do so. He touched the ropes on it's way back so the umpire rules it as a maximum after getting the confirmation. But credit to Steven Smith for pulling off such an effort. He walks off the field as he gets attended by the physios.

Oh my God! What happened here? Steven Smith seems to have injured himself badly while performing a miracle save. The ball was destined to clear the ropes but Smith flew like Superman and managed to claw it back in but the landing was rough and he hit his head right in the turf. The umpires though check the replay and a six has been given as Smith's body was already over the ropes when he tried to claw the ball back in.
Maheesh Theekshana is in at number 10.

OUT! CAUGHT! Is that the knockout blow? A full toss, on middle. Pathum Nissanka smashes it to deep square leg. Pat Cummins dives forward and takes a good low catch. Australia will be a little relieved now. This could have been a no ball as well but it dipped enough and Pathum Nissanka will have to depart. A fine knock comes to an end. Sri Lanka would be very proud of him no matter what the outcomes of this match comes. 12 needed from 3 balls. The umpires also tells Maheesh Theekshana the new man in that the batters did cross but not before the catch was taken, so he will be on strike.
Commentary.Howout: c Pat Cummins b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: Very full and outside off, Pathum Nissanka squeezes it out to long off. Two taken comfortably. Dushmantha Chameera was ready to sacrifice but the throw came at the striker's end.
FOUR! Pathum Nissanka is keeping Sri Lanka in the game! All hopes lies on his shoulders. Pathum Nissanka shimmies down the track and lifts this length ball over mid off for a boundary. 14 needed now!
WIDE! Not the start Australia wanted. Length ball, way past the tramline on the off side. Wided.
Dushmantha Chameera is the new man in. Marcus Stoinis (2-0-13-0) has been thrown the ball to bowl the final over. Can he defend 18 runs?

OUT! TAKEN! This match keeps swinging like a pendulum! Length ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to heave it away. He lifts it straight down the throat of Pat Cummins who takes a good catch at deep extra cover. 19 needed from 6 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Pat Cummins b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Two again! Brilliant running! Wide yorker, Wanindu Hasaranga digs it out to deep backward point. The pair runs hard to get two. The throw is a bit wild one as well and that helps Sri Lanka's cause.
Short again, on off. Pathum Nissanka mistimes his pull to mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Has Glenn Maxwell put down another one! Josh Hazlewood bowls it right on the slot, on middle. Pathum Nissanka stands tall and whips it off the pads to deep mid-wicket. Glenn Maxwell runs across and tries to catch it and flick it back but spills it and the ball lands over the ropes.
Full and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga smashes it to mid off for a single. Pathum Nissanka back on strike.
A good start to the over! Slower ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Short of a length, on off. Pathum Nissanka looks to pull but it goes off the under edge to fine leg. He pushes hard for the second run and gets it easily. Excellent running! 29 needed from 12 balls!

SIX! BANG! Pathum Nissanka picked that up an picked it well. Short of a length, on middle. A horrizontal bat shot from Pathum Nissanka over deep mid-wicket. That made a cracking sound and it goes all the way for a biggie. Another boundary here and that would really lift the team up.
Short of a length, on middle. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to pull but gets an under edge onto the pitch. A single is taken.

FOUR! Sri Lanka are not out of the chase yet! On a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga makes room and steers it to backward point. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and dives but the ball wins the race.
Bangs it short, on middle. Wanindu Hasaranga again tries to upper cut but misses this time.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Short of a length, outside off, was a slower one. Wanindu Hasaranga upper cuts it to third man for a boundary.
Pat Cummins (3-0-13-1) is back on.
Full and outside off, Pathum Nissanka tries to sweep it now but fails to connect. Excellent over from Kane Richardson! Just 4 runs off it. 44 needed from 18 balls.
A full toss, outside off. Pathum Nissanka gets inside the line and paddles it towards short fine leg. Didn't hit it from the middle of the bat but will get a couple.
On a length, dabbed down to third man for a run.
FIFTY! Pathum Nissanka's first fifty against Australia and fourth overall. Length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka taps it to point for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga is in at number 8.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Kane Richardson bags his first wicket now. Bowls a short ball, on middle. Chamika Karunaratne went for the pull but mistimes. The ball goes off the top edge and goes high up in the air. Matthew Wade calls for the catch and gulps down the skier.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off. Karunaratne hangs back and dabs it down towards backward point.
Chamika Karunaratne is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Extraordinary fielding from Australia and just like that, Australia are back on top. Dasun Shanaka was taking on te charge but has to walk back to the pavilion now. Adam Zampa bowls a loopy ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka bunts it to wide of deep mid-wicket. He pushes hard for the second run. Steven Smith quickly collects the ball and throws t in one motion to the bowler's end. Hits the bullseye and Dasun Shanaka is caught short. 50 needed from 24 balls.

Is that a Run-Out? Has Steven Smith pulled off something special here? The batters push hard for two and Smith with a bullet throw from the deep, shatters the stumps at the bowler's end. Dasun Shanaka looks to be in trouble and the decision is sent upstairs. The replays roll in and we can see that even the desperate dive couldn't save Shanaka. It is OUT on the big screen and the answer to the previous question is 'Yes, he can!'
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Dasun Shanaka looks to slog but gets it off the bottom half to long on for a single.
Darted on middle, Pathum Nissanka nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Pathum Nissanka looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Top edge but as long as the runs are coming, Sri Lanka won't mind. Tossed up, outside off, Pathum Nissanka reverse-sweeps it. The ball goes off the top edge over short third man for a boundary.
Floats it up, on the pads. Dasun Shanaka clips it to square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery, on leg. Shanaka gets an inside edge onto the leg side for a single. 18 off the over and now 58 more required off 30 balls.
SIX! Geez, he's timed that well! On the pads, Dasun Shanaka picks it up and whips it all the way, over the backward square leg fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Similar delivery to the previous one. This time Shanaka plays a good-cricketing shot and gets a boundary. A slower length ball, wide of off. This is slapped through covers for a boundary.
Shanaka tries to be cheeky when he has been hitting it so well down the ground. Good-length ball, around off. Shanaka shuffles and looks to scoop it over the keeper but misses.

SIX! Dasun Shanaka is on fire at the moment! Fullish, on middle. Shanka stands tall and smokes it high and handsome, right back over the bowler's head. The ball flies well over the ropes and Sri Lanka still very much in it.
A length ball, angled into off. Nissanka backs away and plays it through cover-point for a single.
Kane Richardson (2-0-22-0) comes back into the attack.
FOUR! The skipper turning it on here. Short and wide, this is slapped away into the vacant cover fence. 76 still needed off 36 balls. Can Sri Lanka pull it off?
Around the top of middle. This is pulled down towards long on for just another single.
Nicely bowled! Full and wide, Nissanka can't get to it.
On the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for one.
Length again, outside off. Shanaka goes after it but doesn't make a connection.
Pat Cummins pulls out before delivering the ball. It was actually Dasun Shanaka who wasn't ready to face the delivery.
WIDE! Full and wide, a bit too wide for the umpire's liking.
On a good length, close to the off stump. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.

Dropped! You just don't see Glenn Maxwell dropping those but he has done so on this occasion. Dasun Shanaka tries to repeat the trick but Zampa pushes it wider. Shanaka still forces the big shot and the ball flies right back over the bowler's head. Maxwell runs around from the long on fence and spills it. Maybe he was a bit wary about the rope. Single taken.

SIX! Dasun Shanaka picks the right delivery to go big and gets all of it. Tossed up, around middle. Shanka skips down the track and hist through the line to dispatch it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Flighted this time, on off and spinning away. Nissanka lifts it over extra cover without much timing and picks up a single.
Tossed up, around leg. Good use of the feet from Shanaka to work it through mid on for a single.
Dragged down, around off and goes unpunished. Nissanka pulls it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for just a single. The boundaries have completely dried up for the visitors.
Very full, on off. This is squeezed out to extra cover.
A length ball, on leg. Dasun Shanaka just walks past his stumps and looks to scoop it behind but misses the ball.
Jagging back in from around off. Nissanka is pinged back but manages to open the face of the bat ever so slightly and get it down to third man for another single.
Shorter in length, on the body. This is tucked away off his hips by Dasun Shanaka for a run.
Hazlewood hits the length hard, around off. Nissanka hops but the ball stays a bit low. Nissanka manages to steer it down to third man for a single.
Leg bye! Length again, angling into the pads. Shanaka misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg. The batters sneak in a leg bye.
On a good length, around off and just nips away a bit off the surface. Shanaka has a poke at it but the ball zips past the outside edge.
on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Out walks the Sri Lankan skipper, Dasun Shanaka.

OUT! Cleaned up! A wrong choice of shot from Dinesh Chandimal and that has led to his downfall. Just when Sri Lanka were finding their feet in the chase, Adam Zampa comes back in and tightens the screws, to an extent that the batter just decides to take him on. This is quicker, fuller and on middle. Chandimal plays all around a straight ball as he looks for the slog. The ball goes through bat and pad and crashes into middle. Sri Lanka slump a bit further now.
Sliding into middle and leg, Chandimal tucks it towards mid-wicket.
A touch short and wide, this is cut away to deep point for a run.
A googly now, shorter, on off and turning in sharply. Dinesh Chandimal goes on the back foot and pushes it out through extra cover for one more.
This is dragged down, around leg. Nissanka eases it through wide mid on for a single.
Adam Zampa (1-0-4-0) is back on.
Back of a length, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal dabs it to cover. At the halfway mark, Sri Lanka are 64/3. 101 needed from 60 balls now.
Slower ball, on middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka glances it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka leans onto it and caresses it through covers for another boundary.

FOUR! Poor from Aaron Finch! A misfield and that goes for a boundary. Short of a length, on off. Pathum Nissanka dabs it to backward point. Aaron Finch tries to collect it quickly and throw it at the stumps as there was a run out opportunity. But instead, the ball goes through his legs and into the fence.
Very full and outside off, Dinesh Chandimal steers it to sweeper cover for a single.
A low dipping yorker, on off. Pathum Nissanka digs it out to the off side for a single.
Kane Richardson (1-0-11-0) is brought back into the attack.
Back of a length again, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal looks to pull but misses. Gets hit in the back and the ball rolls back to the keeper.
Short of a length, outside off. Cut away hard but straight to point.
Length ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka shuffles across and tickes it to fine leg for a run.
Length ball, on off. Dinesh Chandimal taps it to point for a quick single.
On a good length, on off. Dinesh Chandimal taps it to backward point.
SIX! Stand and deliver! That has gone miles over! Length ball, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal picks the bones out of that one. Hammers it all the way over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Marcus Stoinis (1-0-5-0) is back on.
Quicker and shorter, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal cuts it to point and retains the strike.
Pushed quicker, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to cut but misses.
Quicker one, on off. Pushed towards covers.
Short and wide, cut to sweeper cover for a single.

On leg, Dinesh Chandimal looks to tuck but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batters take a leg bye. Matthew Wade quickly collects it and throws it to Glenn Maxwell. He back-flicks it trying to run out Dinesh Chandimal but that doesn't hit the stumps.
Flatter, on the pads. Dinesh Chandimal clips it to deep square leg for a couple of runs. Good running!
Spin from both ends as Glenn Maxwell is brought into the attack.
Turning in, on middle and leg. Dinesh Chandimal works it to long on for a single.
On off, Dinesh Chandimal chops it back onto the keeper. Matthew Wade whips the bails off but Dinesh Chandimal was inside the crease.
Fraction short, outside off. Punched towards covers for one.
Drfting it, on middle and leg. Dinesh Chandimal clips it to square leg for a run.
Short and on middle, a half-tracker. Pathum Nissanka mistimes his pull completely as he gets it from the toe end onto his pads. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batters take a single.
Floats it up, on leg. Pathum Nissanka keeps it out on the leg side.
Adam Zampa comes into the attack now.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! They are attacking Kane Richardson and are attacking well. Short ball, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal makes room and plays it over point for a boundary. End of the Powerplay, Sri Lanka are 36/3.
Short of a length, on off. Pathum Nissanka hops and dabs it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka stays back and uses the pace of the ball. He cuts it through point for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal makes room and guides it to deep backward point for a single.
On a length, on off. Pathum Nissanka dabs it to short third man and gets a single this time. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Good start from Richardson! Back of a length, angling in, on middle. Pathum Nissanka hops and dabs it to short third man.
Kane Richardson is introduced into the attack now.

It's the big in-dipper this time. Starts on off and ends down the leg side. Dinesh Chandimal looks to flick but the ball comes off the pads and Matthew Wade makes a good take down to his left. The hosts appeal for caught behind but the umpire isn't interested.
Too close for comfort! Length again, around off and this one nips back in sharply. Chandimal gets cut in half as he tries to block.
Dinesh Chandimal walks out to bat.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! 'Deja vu' for the hosts as the top order crumbles yet again. Pat Cummins bowls it around the top of off and it's just the perfect length. Charith Asalanka hangs deep and just tries to run the ball to third man but it is too close to the body. In the end, Asalanka only manages to get a faint inside edge on it and the ball goes on to dislodge the bails. Australia on top of proceedings here.
A big swing and miss from Asalanka. A touch fuller, angling across and just dragged a bit wider. Asalanka looks to muscle it over mid-wicket but makes no connection with the ball.
Around the top of off. Kept out by Asalanka.
Back of a length, slanting onto the hips. Nissanka tucks it 'round the corner for a single.
Nicely bowled! An off-paced delivery, angled across the left-hander. Charith Asalanka looks to go big over mid off but completely misses the ball.
On a good length, over middle. Asalanka hops and keeps it down on the leg side.
Shorter in length, outside off. Nissanka taps it through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Width on offer this time and Pathum Nissanka drags it high and towards the vacant mid-wicket fence. The ball trickles into the boundary.
On a hard length this time, around off. Nissanka dabs it down to backward point.
Around the top of off. This is driven straight to mid off.
Charith Asalanka is the new batsman in. A bowling chage as well. Marcus Stoinis is brought into the attack. He replaces Pat Cummins.

OUT! TAKEN! Josh Hazlewood picks up his second wicket and Avishka Fernando has to depart early. Length again, this is pushed a bit wider. Fernando looks to drive on the up and does so a fair bit away from the body. His feet don't move and hence, Fernando can't quite get to the pitch of the ball. He ends up hitting it uppishly and Josh Inglis at short cover springs to his left and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Inglis b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Sliding down leg, Nissanka gets a slight tickle and runs it down towards fine leg. One more for the batting side.
Length again, close to the off pole. Fernando edges it down with soft hands towards third man for a single.
Good-length delivery, on off. This is punched straight towards cover.
FOUR! A short ball, down leg. Avishka Fernando goes for the pull but gets a top edge on it. The ball flies away fine and runs away into the fence for another boundary.
Leg bye! A length ball, on off and angling in a long way. Nissanka hops and looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes off the pads and rolls onto the off side. They get a leg bye.
Around off, this is guided towards backward point.
Just over! Short and wide, Pathum Nissanka has a crack at it. He slices it and the ball just flies past the jumping gully fielder towards third man. They get one.
FOUR! Crunched! This is pushed wider, Nissanka makes a bit of room and thumps it through the cover region for a boundary.
Angled onto middle. Nissanka looks to keep it out leg side but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.

FOUR LEG BYES! Cheeky but effective! Length again, around off. Pathum Nissanka shuffles across the stumps and gets inside the line of the ball. He misses the flick but the ball goes off his pads and runs away fine into the fence.
A good length ball, outside off. Nissanka looks to fetch it but there's good bounce on offer and the ball zips past the bat.
Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length, around off. This is chopped towards cover. Just 3 runs and a wicket off the first over.
Avishka Fernando walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! TAKEN! Soft dismissal and Danushka Gunathilaka is out for a golden duck! Short of a good length, around off and angling away. Gunathilaka hangs back and looks to cut it away. The ball is a bit too close to the body and Gunathilaka ends up hitting it straight to Ben McDermott at the cover region. McDermott takes a sharp catch and Josh Hazlewood provides Australia with a dream start.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben McDermott b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter this time, on the body. Nissanka sort of half pulls it down to the backward square leg fence for a run.
Pathum Nissanka and Sri Lanka are underway. Length again, this is pushed wider. Nissanka edges it wide of third man and picks up a couple.

And again! Lovely delivery from Josh yet again. Right around the top of off and nipping back in sharply off the surface. Nissanka gets beaten on the inside edge and the ball goes agonizingly past the off stump.
Right on the money from Josh Hazlewood! A good length delivery, around off and nipping back in. Nissanka looks to play away from the body but gets cut in half.
